<tool_calls>
<invoke name="exec_command">
<parameter name="cmd" string="true">cat > /tmp/dsml_probe4.go <<'GOEOF'
package main

import (
	"fmt"
	"regexp"
)

func main() {
	re := regexp.MustCompile(`(?i)(</?)(?:[|｜]\s*|d\s*s\s*m\s*l\s*)+`)
	cases := []string{
		"cat <dsml_config",
		"cat <dsml_config",
		"</||DSML||invoke>",
		"a <d s m l b",
	}
	for _, s := range cases {
		fmt.Printf("in=%q loc=%v replace=%q\n", s, re.FindStringIndex(s), re.ReplaceAllString(s, "$1"))
	}
}
GOEOF
go run /tmp/dsml_probe4.go</parameter>

</parameter>
